principalFinding: V6 learned-event admission repeats V5's under-admission pathology: useful ranking on the stronger fold but catastrophic probability calibration at the frozen 0.50 start gate.

interpretation.p2Fold: Underlying temporal/state representation is useful. The learned event head has strong ranking signal but its absolute probabilities are badly calibrated, so the fixed 0.50 gate suppresses almost all true events.
interpretation.p1Fold: This fold shows broader representation collapse, not merely event-gate calibration failure.

designDecision.nextDirection: Return to V4-class state/activity decoding strength and design event starts without a validation-sensitive probability threshold, e.g. train-time structured boundary/objective or relative/ranking-based admission fixed before validation.
